Riley Chen: Fwding the PM follow-up for the sticky regression we saw last week. Need clear owners + ETA for each action by EOD.
Priya Kapoor: I can own the query-cache follow-up. Will open a JIRA and link here. ETA: next sprint (end of week +7).
Samir Patel: I'll take infra rollback investigation and the fallback routing test. JIRA will be RED-9921.
Irene Gomez: I'll own the post-deploy canary checklist update and add the runbook blurb. Target: 3 business days.
Riley Chen: @Priya @Samir please add RACI in the ticket comments. We need a single accountable owner for each item and a reviewer.
Priya Kapoor: ack. I'll create tickets now and assign reviewers: @Irene for runbook changes, @Riley for final signoff on rollout policy.
ops-bot: Automated note: Postmortem saved -> https://redwood.postmortems/pm-1789 (exported summary)
Samir Patel: Created RED-9921 (infra rollback) and RED-9922 (fallback routing e2e). Assigning @Riley as reviewer. Link: https://jira.redwood/RED-9921
Priya Kapoor: Created RED-9923 (query cache pinning) and RED-9924 (cache eviction alert tuning). Assigned @Irene reviewer. Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-9923
Irene Gomez: Added acceptance criteria to RED-9924: 
```
- Alert fires within 2m of evic threshold
- Test harness run in staging
- Rollout plan with kill-switch
```
Riley Chen: Quick RACI check:
- RED-9921: R=Samir, A=Samir, C=Irene, I=Platform Eng
- RED-9923: R=Priya, A=Priya, C=Riley, I=Product
Can folks confirm or propose changes?
Priya Kapoor: Confirmed.
Samir Patel: Confirmed. I'll ping if scope expands.
Irene Gomez: Confirmed, will review RED-9923/24 once PRs are up.
Riley Chen: OK. Action timeline summary:
- Infra investigation (RED-9921) — owner Samir — due +3 days
- Fallback routing tests (RED-9922) — owner Samir — due +5 days
- Query cache fixes (RED-9923) — owner Priya — due +7 days
- Eviction alert tuning (RED-9924) — owner Priya/Irene — due +4 days
Riley Chen: I'll follow up in tomorrow's PM sync to mark blockers. If anyone needs to reassign, update the JIRA and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
